groundedResult_1.question: Can I carry forward unused leaves to the next calendar year?
groundedResult_1.answer: Yes. Up to a maximum of 45 days of Paid Leave (PL) can be carried forward into the next calendar year. Any accrued balance exceeding 45 days on December 31st will automatically lapse unless encashment is explicitly sanctioned under Grade L4+ retention policies.

citations.text: An employee may carry forward an unutilized balance of Earned/Privilege Leave up to a maximum accumulation limit of 45 working days.

citations.text: Probation separation requires 15 calendar days notice; confirmed status mandates 60 calendar days.
